description: Utility class for handling java.util.Date, java.sql date/time classes, and related date/time operations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilDateTime
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for date/time manipulation, formatting, and conversions.

classes.name: ImmutableDate
classes.description: Private static class extending Date to provide an immutable date object.

methods.name: nowTimestamp
methods.description: Returns a Timestamp for the current moment.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Converts milliseconds or string to a Timestamp.

methods.name: nowAsString
methods.description: Returns current time in milliseconds as String.

methods.name: nowDateString
methods.description: Returns current date/time as formatted String, default format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'.

methods.name: nowDate
methods.description: Returns current Date object.

methods.name: getDayStart
methods.description: Returns Timestamp for start of day, with optional days later.

methods.name: getDayEnd
methods.description: Returns Timestamp for end of day, with optional days later.

methods.name: getYearStart
methods.description: Returns Timestamp for start of year, with optional days, months, years later.

methods.name: getMonthStart
methods.description: Returns Timestamp for start of month, with optional days later.

methods.name: getWeekStart
methods.description: Returns Timestamp for start of week, with optional days and weeks later.

methods.name: getWeekEnd
methods.description: Returns Timestamp for end of week.

methods.name: toCalendar
methods.description: Converts Timestamp to Calendar object with specified timezone and locale.

methods.name: toSqlDate
methods.description: Converts String or ints to java.sql.Date.

methods.name: toSqlTime
methods.description: Converts String or ints to java.sql.Time.

methods.name: toTimestamp
methods.description: Converts String, date, or separate components to java.sql.Timestamp.

methods.name: toDate
methods.description: Converts String or components to java.util.Date.

methods.name: toDateString
methods.description: Formats Date to String in specified or default format.

methods.name: toTimeString
methods.description: Formats Date or time components to String.

methods.name: toDateTimeString
methods.description: Combines date and time into formatted String.

methods.name: toGmtTimestampString
methods.description: Formats Timestamp as GMT String.

methods.name: monthBegin
methods.description: Returns Timestamp for beginning of current month.

methods.name: weekNumber
methods.description: Returns week number in year for a Timestamp.

methods.name: dayNumber
methods.description: Returns day of week number for a Timestamp.

methods.name: getSecond
methods.description: Gets seconds component from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getMinute
methods.description: Gets minutes component from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getHour
methods.description: Gets hour component from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getDayOfWeek
methods.description: Gets day of week from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getDayOfMonth
methods.description: Gets day of month from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getDayOfYear
methods.description: Gets day of year from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Gets week of year from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getMonth
methods.description: Gets month from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Gets year from Timestamp with timezone and locale.

methods.name: getEarliestDate
methods.description: Returns earliest possible Date in GMT.

methods.name: getLatestDate
methods.description: Returns latest possible Date in GMT.

methods.name: unmodifiableDate
methods.description: Returns an immutable copy of a Date.
